Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
In the minimum following-distance table, the packed snow and ice rows extracted with fewer values than there are speed columns, so it is unclear which speeds those values belong to or whether some cells are blank; only the ideal, wet pavement and gravel rows are used [A07] (verify NJ-DEF-D-TABLE).
This chapter defines stopping distance as perception plus reaction plus braking distance, while the earlier stopping table adds only reaction and braking distance; each is reported as printed on its own page [A06].
The manual gives three following-time guidelines on different pages (normal, bad weather and snow-covered roads); each is kept as printed rather than merged [A06].
The aggressive-driver hotline numbers are service details isolated as dynamic [A02].
